The '''H-2 executive shuttle''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model manufactured during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Gotcha-ZBSB.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Zillo Beast captures Palpatine's executive shuttle]]
An [[Palpatine's H-2 executive shuttle/Legends|H-2]] was installed as an alternate escape route for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]] in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. When the Executive Building was [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|attacked]] by a rampant [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]], Palpatine and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] attempted to use the ship to escape the beast. When the creature grabbed the craft in its enormous hands, Skywalker used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut the ship in half, thereby breaking the beast's grip on it.<ref name="TZBSB" />

Later in the war, [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] used a [[Mina Bonteri's H-2 executive shuttle/Legends|red-shaded H-2 shuttle]] to secretly transport Padmé Amidala and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] from a [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to Bonteri's [[Bonteri house/Legends|mansion]] on [[Raxus Secundus|Raxus]].<ref name="HOBS" />
